input: calories is an ordinary list/array of n <= 10000000 integers in [0,1000000]; k is an integer in [1,10000000]. lower and upper are safe integers with lower <= upper. return: For each complete length-k window add -1 if its sum is below lower, +1 if above upper, otherwise 0. Return the total score.

numeric: Even the temporary sum before outgoing removal is at most 10000000000000, below 2^53; score magnitude is at most n.
